title: Marcos congratulates Lula for 'famous reelection' at PH-Brazil bilateral meeting
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. congratulated Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on his recent reelection during their bilateral meeting ahead of the ASEAN Summit.
